title: Support policy
description: The venture's customer support policy, at support/policy.json (route support/policy): the channels customers use, the hours, the response targets, the refund rule and when a case goes to a person. It follows APQC PCF 6.1.3 to 6.1.5 (channel strategy, policies and procedures, service levels per segment) and ISO 10002:2018 (complaints handling). The customer service function owns it, and only the customer service agent (role customer-service-agent) or a person writes it. A person decides it: every agent write is held as a draft under public-commitment, because customers rely on what it promises.

hours.description: When it is answered, such as weekdays 9 to 5 US Central

connection.description: The connection record (it/connections/<id>.json) for the helpdesk tool behind it, if any

targets.description: Service level targets (APQC 6.1.5): how fast a first reply and a resolution should come, per channel and segment

channel.description: The channel it applies to; absent means every channel

segment.description: The customer segment or plan it applies to; absent means every customer

first_response_hours.description: Hours to the first reply from a person or an agent

business_hours.description: True when the hours count only the channel's open hours

refunds.description: The refund and credit rule. Every refund moves money, so in Naive it is a spend-money decision a person makes; the limit says what a person may grant on a case without further review

rule.description: When a customer gets a refund or credit, in plain words

escalate_when.description: What sends a case to a person at once

reasons.description: The contact reason list every case is tagged with (contact drivers, Price and Jaffe, The Best Service Is No Service)

reviewed.description: When a person last reviewed the policy
